title: BETTER SAMPLING IN EXPLANATION METHODS CAN PREVENT DIESELGATE-LIKE DECEPTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on the robustness of post-hoc explanation methods (LIME, SHAP, IME) against adversarial manipulation in the context of machine learning model bias. While it uses datasets related to social fairness (like COMPAS) and discusses unethical deception, it does not evaluate or benchmark moral, religious, or ethical reasoning frameworks, nor does it involve Large Language Models.
